toml:
# GNSS positioning joined by the two ESA Celeste in-orbit demonstration satellites.
#
# The `celeste-iod` preset is the ONLY place in the engine that uses parameters presented at
# the ESA NAVISP LEO-PNT workshop, 2026 (the E5 pilot signal of IOD configuration #1 and its
# pass C/N0 range); the orbit (510 km, near-polar sun-synchronous) is public (ION GNSS+ 2026
# abstract 16907). This file and src/leo_fusion/presets/celeste_iod.rs can be deleted
# together to publish without those parameters. The IOD signals are an experiment vehicle,
# not the design of any future system.
#
# A receiver in Noordwijk tracks GPS and Galileo; when a Celeste IOD satellite is above the
# mask its pseudorange joins the fix. The IOD signals are synchronised to GNSS time with a
# broadcast time-of-transmission correction, so the LEO system is declared on the reference
# time scale (`clock = "known"`): a single LEO satellite then adds a measurement instead of
# only an inter-system bias. MODELLED.
kind = "leo-pvt"
mode = "joint"
seed = 4
duration_s = 5700.0
step_s = 30.0

[user]
lat_deg = 52.22
lon_deg = 4.42
height_m = 5.0

[joint]
max_leo_sweep = 2

[[system]]
name = "GPS"
preset = "gps-baseline"
cn0_dbhz = [38.0, 48.0]

[[system]]
name = "Galileo"
preset = "galileo"
cn0_dbhz = [38.0, 48.0]
isb_ns = 12.0

[[system]]
name = "Celeste IOD"
leo_preset = "celeste-iod"
signal = "E5"
clock = "known"
